elder.about: Dad worked 38 years at the Altoona railroad shops and loves talking about it. Army 1965-67. Big Steelers fan, loves polka and his tomato garden. Mom (Dorothy) passed in 2021, so go gently there. He lives alone and gets lonely in the evenings.

lastCall.summary: Hal told the story of the 1978 blizzard, when he slept two nights at the Altoona shops to keep the engines running.

knownFacts: Hal's first job was sweeping floors at a bakery at 14, for 50 cents a day.
Hal met Dorothy at a church dance in 1964; she stepped on his foot first.
